text:
Situation: Polyethylene glycol 3350 and electrolytes with orange flavor is not on FDA's drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Corvale Lakeside holds 15 units with 8.9 days on hand. Corvale General holds 271 units with 27.7 days on hand. Corvale East holds 182 units with 24.9 days on hand. A separate manufacturer, Salix Pharmaceuticals, a division of Bausch Health US, LLC, has a different formulation posted as To Be Discontinued on 2026-08-13.

Why (FDA record): FDA's most recent inspection of the Strides Pharma Science Limited plant (FEI 3004554612) ended on 2026-05-20 and was classified VAI. The product is not listed on FDA's shortage list as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Current inventory at Corvale General and Corvale East supports an internal transfer to cover Corvale Lakeside's low days on hand. No shortage listing exists for this formulation. External purchases are available from multiple suppliers not on the shortage list, but their labels name no identifiable plants.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 9 units of 236 g/4 L + 22.74 g/4 L + 6.74 g/4 L + 5.86 g/4 L + 2.97 g/4 L, 4 L from Corvale General to Corvale Lakeside — needs pharmacy director approval for transfer request.
2. If Corvale General cannot supply, transfer 9 units from Corvale East to Corvale Lakeside — needs pharmacy director approval for transfer request.
3. If internal transfer is not feasible, purchase from Affordable Pharmaceuticals, LLC — needs buyer approval.
4. If internal transfer is not feasible, purchase from Aurobindo Pharma Limited — needs buyer approval.
5. If internal transfer is not feasible, purchase from Azurity Pharmaceuticals, Inc. — needs buyer approval.

Not recommended: No action that would leave Corvale Lakeside below 14 days on hand.
